prompt:
You are a probe. Do not explain and do not retry. Perform exactly ONE step.

Step 1. Call mcp__hallpass__tabs_context once, with no arguments. This is the first call of a freshly unpaired agent, so it will raise a pairing prompt; the probe accepts that prompt about 20 seconds later. Wait for the call to return whatever it returns.

Answer with JSON only, matching the schema.
- In steps, put one entry: tool = the exact tool name, outcome = the tool result verbatim (or its error text), truncated to 400 characters.
- In observed: write "paired-same-call" if this very first call succeeded after the pairing was accepted. Otherwise write the failure reason exactly as reported, for example "timed-out", "not-paired", "bridge-unavailable".
- Do NOT call the tool a second time under any circumstance: whether the FIRST call survives the pairing wait is the entire measurement.
expectedAfterFix: SC-031: with the owner accepting 20 s after the prompt appears, the triggering call succeeds in the same call (FR-059, R-112)
